ui.tagline: Every star is a text from Bloodborne. The more two texts talk about the same things, the closer they sit.
ui.aria: Map of Bloodborne's texts: each star is a text, and texts close together talk about the same things. Arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom, Enter to open the targeted star.
